The structure of Dy6Fe2 (reduced formula Dy3Fe) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 143), with eight atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies two environments: Dy centers with 10 geometric neighbors (8 Dy and 2 Fe) and Fe centers with 12 neighbors (8 Dy and 4 Fe) in a close-packed-like local arrangement. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Dy 10-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Fe 12-vertex polyhedra share edges.
